Confirmed via the department page's embedded mega-menu JSON block (block_id 1888) listing all Travel & Leisure sub-nodes (Bagage, Kamperen, Sport, Reisaccessoires, Huisdieraccessoires, etc). The 3 products are 'Hondenspeeltje sneeuwpop - wit' (dog toy snowman), 'Hondenspeeltje kerstman - rood' (dog toy santa), and 'Hondentouw - 23x10x6 cm' (dog rope toy) -- all genuine Tier-1 pet toys/enrichment, not pet-themed decor. Cross-checked the full product sitemap (https://www.xenos.nl/storage/sitemap/default/sitemap.xml, 38175 URLs) for other 'hond'/'kat'/'huisdier' product slugs outside this category: found additional dog/cat items (honden-mand dog baskets, kattenhuis cat houses, katten-speelgoed cat toys) but every one of them resolves to schema.org/OutOfStock on its PDP and has no distinct category/PLP URL of its own (no breadcrumb category path in JSON-LD, no dedicated listing page) -- these are discontinued/orphaned product pages still indexed in the sitemap, not a live navigable category, so per the 'drop zero-product categories' rule no row is emitted for them. No other pet-specific nav node exists anywhere on the site (checked homepage nav/mega-menu markup and the full department structure documented in the prior Home-Decor pass, which explicitly noted the Reizen en vrije tijd branch as 'verified via its own sub-nav' -- that prior pass excluded it wholesale for having 'zero decor relevance' without registering the pet accessories leaf since decor was its only lens). No overlaps with other categories (Furniture/Storage/etc) to adjudicate: this is the site's only pet-specific catalogue node.
